description: Decode the eth_call result YOUR node returned for a USD value (`usd.in` of prepare_quote with usd:true, or `usdOut` of decode_quote): the amount in USD (via USDC; USDG on Robinhood Chain; the dollar token counts as 1 USD), measured as Quoter netOut after the 0.28% fee, including price impact. Each via (direct, via WETH, via the tokens the direct route crosses; at most 8) is listed; the value is the minimum over measured vias, with the spread when two or more are measured. A via that reverts, finds no route or nets 0 is "not measured"; with none measured the value is "not measured", never 0. When the route crosses other tokens, the answer is `next`: a second eth_call pinned at the block hash of the first (EIP-1898, requireCanonical); run it and decode that one. That needs blockHash, the hash of the block the first call ran at (read the header with eth_getBlockByNumber and pin the call there, or pass blockHash to prepare_quote, which pins usd.in only). usdOut of decode_quote is prepared at latest: replace latest with {blockHash, requireCanonical: true} of a header you read, run it, and pass that hash here as blockHash. Without a hash the value is "not measured", never a call pinned by number. If your node answers an error for the hash, start again. Pure computation.

blockHash.description: the hash of the block the first USD call ran at (optional; needed when the route crosses other tokens)

request.description: the `request` object of the USD call (usd.in, usdOut or next), verbatim

result.description: the 0x hex result of that eth_call on your node

name: decode_usd_value
title: Decode a USD value
